name: aria-context-score
description: Evaluates whether each ARIA reasoning step is contextually appropriate.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: Every step perfectly appropriate for the current context.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Mostly contextually appropriate; one minor context mismatch.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Generally appropriate but missed a contextual nuance.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Key contextual factors ignored such as wrong channel formatting.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Completely context-unaware — ignores channel, auth state, and customer context.
